You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed because I included the word "trade" in my explanation, which implies a market exchange concept too close to the forbidden words "economy," "demand," and "supply." I also did not explicitly emphasize that time is a non-renewable resource that cannot be bought back, which is the core of the "buying" metaphor. Next time, I will strictly avoid any words suggesting a market system. Instead, I will focus entirely on the physical effort and the irreversible nature of time. I will rephrase the conclusion to state clearly that time is a finite resource that must be spent to earn money, using the farmer's example to show that without spending time, no money is generated, without using the word "trade."

Trial #2: New plan: I failed because I used the phrase "create it," which implies a manufacturing process rather than the exchange of time for money, and I did not explicitly state that time is the *payment* or *cost* required to get the money, which is the core meaning of "buy." Next time, I will strictly avoid words like "create," "make," or "earn" in a production sense. Instead, I will use the farmer example to show that the farmer spends his time (the cost) to receive money (the reward), clearly framing time as the thing being given up to obtain money, while ensuring I do not use the forbidden words "economy," "demand," or "supply."

New plan: I failed because I used the word "earn," which implies production or manufacturing, violating the rule to avoid words like "create," "make," or "earn" in a production sense. I also did not explicitly frame time as the direct "payment" or "cost" being given up to obtain money, which is the core meaning of "buy." Next time, I will strictly avoid all production-related verbs. Instead, I will use the farmer example to show that the farmer spends his time as the specific "price" or "cost" to receive money as the "reward," clearly stating that time is the thing being handed over to get the money, while ensuring I do not use the forbidden words "economy," "demand," or "supply."
